# .github/autonomy/imports-allow.txt — what an `auto` file may import.
#
# Owner: Jon. Read by scripts/autonomy_class.py from v3/main only.
# Added for PR #351 review R1 finding 3: the import rule is an ALLOW list,
# not a blocklist over lib/. An import in a changed file is `auto` only if:
#   * it resolves (first existing file, TypeScript resolution order, in the
#     head tree) to a path listed here EXACTLY, or
#   * it resolves to another path that allow.txt admits and deny.txt does not
#     (a sibling UI component or CSS module), or
#   * it is a bare package name listed here EXACTLY.
# deny.txt `import:` lines win over this file.
# Everything else is `human`: any other apps/web/src/lib/** module, server
# code, an unlisted package, an unresolvable or non-canonical specifier.
#
# Format: one exact repo path or package name per line. No globs: a new file
# in lib/play/ is NOT admitted until someone reviews it and adds it here.
#
# HOW THIS LIST WAS BUILT (2026-11-23, main @ ebd0a8f): the modules that
# today's components import, kept only if the module, with comments removed,
# matches none of deny.txt's content/code patterns (no fetch, no /api/, no
# env, no globalThis, no "use server"...) AND everything it imports is itself
# on this list or a listed package (checked transitively). Modules that
# components import but that FAIL this test are deliberately absent, e.g.
# lib/play/sections, lib/play/presets, lib/set-lists, lib/library,
# lib/song-thumb, lib/job-label, lib/analytics, lib/upload*, lib/pending-link,
# lib/public-config (process.env). A component importing one of them is
# `human`.
#
# The listed modules are themselves DENIED for editing (deny.txt
# apps/web/src/lib/**), so their content can only change through a reviewed
# PR. Whoever reviews that PR should re-check that the module still belongs
# here.

# ── Packages ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
react
react-dom
next/navigation
next/link
@stem-loops/types

# ── Pure client modules (no network, no env, no server code) ─────────────────
# Shared button/input class strings.
apps/web/src/lib/ui/form-styles.ts
# Player types, chord notation and display helpers.
apps/web/src/lib/play/types.ts
apps/web/src/lib/play/notation.ts
apps/web/src/lib/play/simplify-chords.ts
apps/web/src/lib/play/part-pills.ts
apps/web/src/lib/play/device-support.ts
apps/web/src/lib/play/wake-lock.ts
apps/web/src/chord/alphabet.ts
# Navigation highlight, waveform palette, demo song catalogue (static data).
apps/web/src/lib/nav-current.ts
apps/web/src/lib/wave-colors.ts
apps/web/src/lib/demo-catalog.ts
